description: This PHP source file defines the ViewCandidateController class within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It extends an abstract Vue controller to handle pre-rendering logic for viewing candidate information, including setting components and permissions based on request query parameters.

classes.name: ViewCandidateController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling the view candidate page, extending the abstract Vue controller and incorporating permission and candidate service traits.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view component with candidate status information based on request query parameters and sets user permissions for accessing candidate views.
